card.name: Words just before a container noun
card.fires_on: Modifiers or articles right before a container word like can, keg, cup or container, e.g. 'a clean', 'a paint', 'the' in 'out of the can'. The container noun is predicted next.

modes.label: Modifier before can or keg
modes.description: A noun used as a modifier (beer, paint) just before a can or keg shape word.

modes.label: Preparation instructions
modes.description: Article or adjective before 'container' or 'cup' when contents are emptied or mixed.

modes.label: Article before can
modes.description: The word 'the' in a phrase like 'out of the' where 'can' follows.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict container nouns such as pot, cup, tin, mug.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a container like a can, cup or pot, anticipating that noun.
